description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_NightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_NightRun">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Participation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Run5km</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrainAndCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Transport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ArriveMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DrinkWhileRunning</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_App" name="App">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CalcMinutesToWorkEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Finished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Participation" name="Participation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:documentation>Entered into the app.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlock_RunMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RunMerge" name="Merge before run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlock_RunMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Train_RunMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunMerge_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km and measure time">
      <bpmn:documentation>Time is collected by fitness gadget.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunMerge_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run_TimeCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck" name="Under 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotUnder25">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run_TimeCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Train_RunMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GetNumber_Calc</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalcMinutesToWorkEnd" name="Calculate minutes between start and workday end">
      <bpmn:documentation>Computed by the app from the starting time and the end of the workday.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GetNumber_Calc</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calc_Transport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport" name="More than one hour between start and workday end?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calc_Transport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to Night Run from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome_ArriveMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveWork_ArriveMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArriveMerge" name="Arrive at Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome_ArriveMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveWork_ArriveMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArriveMerge_RaceSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceSplit" name="Start running and drinking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArriveMerge_RaceSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Drink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run at Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run_RaceJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Drink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drink_RaceJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceJoin" name="Running and drinking finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run_RaceJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drink_RaceJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Finished" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectBlock" sourceRef="Start_Participation" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlock_RunMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_RunMerge" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunMerge_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RunMerge" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_TimeCheck" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${runTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder25" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_Calc" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CalcMinutesToWorkEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calc_Transport" sourceRef="Task_CalcMinutesToWorkEnd" targetRef="Gateway_Transport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${minutesBetweenStartAndWorkEnd > 60}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome_ArriveMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_ArriveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveWork_ArriveMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_ArriveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArriveMerge_RaceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ArriveMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RaceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_RaceJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RaceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_RaceJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_RaceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="End_Finished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
